Programme Summary by Big Bet
Forecast value attributed to each FY · all values £M · EAB in PB25, FY + AMP8 in the selected price basis · AMP8 = sum FY26-FY30 · click an initiative for its summary
Timeline
When benefit comes on stream across AMP8. Each initiative starts where its benefit begins — bar thickness is £, colour is maturity. Click an initiative for its summary; expand a Big Bet to see its smaller initiatives.
Initiatives
One row per initiative — click a row to edit. Use Categories / Profiles (sub-tabs) for bulk editing across many initiatives.
Categories
Edit EAB and benefit-type splits per initiative. % cells per row must sum to 100% on save. Click an initiative to open the full editor.
Profiles
Monthly maturity % per (Initiative × Benefit Type). 100% = catBenefit ÷ 12 delivered that month. EAB is fixed — edits change AMP8. Direct-£ rows (badged "£") show monthly values at the initiative's own Entry PB.
Monthly View
Drill-down view of monthly values. Expand a Big Bet to see its initiatives; expand an initiative to see its benefit-type splits. Click an FY column header to expand its 12 months. Three display modes: £ per month, % of FY, % of AMP8.
By Release
Programme Summary by Big Bet with per-release maturity columns. Each release column shows the % of the initiative's value live at the end of that release's window (100% = full run-rate reached).
Assumptions
Programme targets, capitalisation splits, and outturn factors. Edit and Save changes — values flow into the Excel export's SSB Targets tab.
Visuals
Governance artefacts — programme value summary, FY value bars, change deep-dives. Snapshots (LBE) freeze current state at a labelled point in time and drive cycle-over-cycle comparison.
Scenarios for Budgeting
Two rows of three scenarios, all starting from the current delivery plan. Top row: delivery timing (lag) scenarios. Bottom row: the same lags plus discovery assumptions. Per box: Labour / Non-Labour lag sliders (fine-tune by benefit type for granular control); the per-FY % inputs say how much of the discovery gap gets delivered each year (can exceed 100%). Non-Totex is excluded throughout; value lagged past Mar 30 leaves the AMP8 window.
Audit Log
Every change to EAB or AMP8 is logged automatically as you edit the plan. AMP8 is captured in Outturn (cash).
Logged changes
One row per save · AMP8 in Outturn (cash), EAB in PB25 · positive (green) = increased, negative (red, parens) = decreased.
Compare versions
Diff two plan-of-record exports — or an export against the current plan. Keyed on initiative code (row order is ignored), showing gross, cost and net-of-cost movement in Outturn (as-reported) or PB25 (like-for-like).
